stem: A clock has its second hand 2 cm long. Find the distance travelled and displacement of the tip of the second hand in 15 seconds.

answer.text: π cm;$2\sqrt{2}$ cm (from the 12 mark to the 3 mark)

assets.alt: Clock face of radius 2 cm with centre O. The tip moves from A at the top (t = 0) along a blue quarter arc, labelled arc = π cm, to B on the right (t = 15 s). A red arrow Δr runs straight from A to B; the radii OA and OB meet at a right angle.
